microsoft-1970393557075501.text: You will be involved with all phases of product development, from microarchitecture design through firmware architecture and development. At the design phase, you will be part of a team- driving the architecture, design and development of the security sub-systems including firmware development of low-level hardware interfaces. You will be responsible for evaluating third party components security design to ensure they meet Azure's requirements for Platform Security Doctorate in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 3+ years technical engineering experience OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 12+ years of professional experience designing and developing software solutions. C/C++, RUST programming skills Experienced with security and embedded software/firmware development. Knowledge in encryption ciphers and security protocols Debugging capabilities and demonstrated experience to resolve issues spanning multiple subsystems. Experience with platform initialization, board support package porting, low level drivers for peripherals such as PCIe, I2C, eMMC, SPI, USB, UARTs as well as Memory Management, Scheduling, Interrupts and multi-threading Defensive coding skills, debugging and troubleshooting abilities. BS in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent industry experience Experience with some or all the following: driver development, Linux driver initialization, peripherals such as PCIe, memory interfaces. OS primitives, memory management, scheduling, interrupts, threading. Experience with penetration testing also a plus

microsoft-1970393557075451.text: Lead hands-on failure analysis across server components: characterize failure modes from fleet telemetry and logs and confirm root cause with repair results and supplier failure analysis. Define the signals, thresholds, targeted diagnostics and repair recipes, and work with component teams for the root cause analysis. Improve isolation accuracy so each repair address the source of failures: improve efficacy of the detection and repair services. Partner with software engineers and data scientists on detection rules and prediction models; set precision targets and validation gates before a rule or model takes action on production nodes. Use AI agents and machine learning to automate failure analysis, live-site triage and supplier RCA follow-up, and to shorten the time from a new failure signature to a detection rule. Lead root cause and corrective actions with server components, including firmware fixes, and feed the learnings back into the platform. Lead as the senior hardware escalation point for live-site incidents, from triage through root cause to fleet-wide mitigation. Make new server generations and AI/GPU platforms platform-ready before they reach production, with detection, isolation and repair coverage at launch. Track and improve metrics & mentor engineers across the team. Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years technical engineering experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience 6+ years of hands-on failure analysis, debug or reliability engineering for server or datacenter hardware, covering two or more server component types 3+ years leading root cause analysis and corrective actions with hardware suppliers, OEMs or ODMs 2+ years using AI or machine learning in hardware engineering work, such as failure analysis, telemetry analysis or automation 10+ years in server hardware reliability, failure analysis or fleet resiliency at cloud or datacenter scale Technical depth in the failure modes of at least one server component type, with working knowledge across the rest of the server (BMC, PCIe, firmware) Experience turning failure signatures into automated detection rules, fault codes or repair procedures for a large fleet Experience with predictive maintenance or anomaly detection on hardware telemetry, including setting precision targets and automated repair actions Proficiency with Kusto (Azure Data Explorer) or SQL, and Python or PowerShell, for large-scale telemetry analysis Experience with NPI and hardware qualification for server platforms Clear written and verbal communication, including presenting technical risk and trade-offs to leadership

Drives identification of dependencies and the development of design documents for a product, application, service, or platform. Creates, implements, optimizes, debugs, refactors, and reuses code to establish and improve performance and maintainability, effectiveness, and return on investment (ROI). Leverages subject-matter expertise of product features and partners with appropriate stakeholders (e.g., project managers) to drive a workgroup's project plans, release plans, and work items. Acts as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) and guides other engineers by developing and following the playbook, working on call to monitor system/product/service for degradation, downtime, or interruptions, alerting stakeholders about status and initiates actions to restore system/product/service for simple and complex problems when appropriate. Proactively seeks new knowledge and adapts to new trends, technical solutions, and patterns that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale. Proficiency in one or more programming languages (such as C#, Python, Go, or Java) with experience in building distributed systems or cloud services. Experience with service-oriented architecture, microservices, or large-scale cloud systems (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP). Demonstrated understanding of secure coding practices, authentication, authorization, and service security fundamentals. Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML or automation frameworks to optimize workflows, detect issues, or enable intelligent decision-making. Solid problem-solving and system design skills, with the ability to translate complex security or compliance requirements into practical, automated solutions. Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code for managing large-scale deployments. Excellent collaboration and communication skills — able to work effectively with cross-functional partners, influence without authority, and drive alignment across teams. Growth mindset with a passion for learning new technologies, especially AI-assisted development and cloud security tooling. Experience as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) or similar operational role, ensuring high service availability and reliability.
